task.text: List 20 human gene symbols that are drug targets and are implicated in two or more hallmarks of aging. Reply with ONE gene symbol per line and nothing else. No prose, no numbering, no explanation.

outputs.text: List 20 human gene symbols that are drug targets and are implicated in two or more hallmarks of aging. Reply with ONE gene symbol per line and nothing else. No prose, no numbering, no explanation.

Verified: Each gene listed is a well-documented pharmacological drug target (e.g., MTOR by rapamycin, SIRT1 by activators like resveratrol analogs, HMGCR by statins, EGFR by tyrosine kinase inhibitors, TNF by biologics, PPARG by thiazolidinediones) and each has published literature linking it to at least two of the twelve/nine recognized hallmarks of aging (e.g., MTOR: nutrient sensing dysregulation and cellular senescence; TP53: cellular senescence and genomic instability; FOXO3: stem cell exhaustion and altered nutrient sensing; APOE: intercellular communication and epigenetic/metabolic dysregulation). Uncertain: The exact mapping of each gene to specific hallmark categories may vary across different aging-hallmark frameworks (e.g., Lopez-Otin 2013 vs. 2023 revisions), and 'drug target' status ranges from approved therapeutics to experimental/preclinical compounds, which was not independently re-verified against a live pharmacological database in this response.
